inputs.name: DesktopBridgeService.constructor.session
inputs.description: ProjectSessionService instance passed to desktopBridge. If its remote property is truthy, bridge() also passes that remote to HostedProjectService and wraps the local bridge; the constructor does not validate the instance.

inputs.name: DesktopBridgeService.constructor.providers
inputs.description: ProviderDiscoveryService instance passed as providers to desktopBridge. This service stores and forwards it without validation or transformation.

inputs.name: DesktopBridgeService.constructor.runs
inputs.description: DesktopRunService instance passed as runs to desktopBridge. This service stores and forwards it without validation or transformation.

inputs.name: DesktopBridgeService.constructor.choose
inputs.description: Asynchronous choice callback passed to desktopBridge and made available to the returned bridge. It resolves to a string or null, and this class does not invoke it or alter its result.

outputs.name: DesktopBridgeService.bridge
outputs.description: The value returned by desktopBridge using the stored services and choice callback. When session.remote is truthy, bridge() returns that value wrapped by HostedProjectService; otherwise it returns the local bridge, and the declared type remains unknown.

outputs.name: DesktopBridgeService.bridge
